comment: GerPII P450 catalyzes hydroxylation at the C8 position to accumulate 8-dehydroxy-12,13-de-epoxydihydrochalcomycin and late-stage intermediate of the 16-membered macrolide antibiotic dihydrochalcomycin (DHC)

reactions.description: GerPII P450 catalyzes hydroxylation at the C8 position of dihydrochalcomycin precursor
